port-wrangler.description: Port Wrangler local infrastructure tools (read-only by default). Modern Streamable-HTTP MCP transport (Spring AI 1.1+). Start Port Wrangler, then add this server in VS Code / Claude / Cursor. To enable write tools (stop/remove), launch with PORTWRANGLER_MCP_WRITE_ENABLED=true. Note: default profile serves port 8080; the 'local' profile uses 8081.
